summary: Decode one 4x4 DXT/BC-style block into 16 float4 colors. Reads two 16-bit endpoint colors from a2[0] and a2[1], decodes each to a float4 via F_16BitColorToFloat4Decoder, then builds a 4-color palette: when endpoint word 0 > endpoint word 1 the palette holds 1/3 and 2/3 interpolation points (4-color mode); otherwise it holds one midpoint plus four zero slots (transparent 2-color mode). A 32-bit selector mask at a2+4 supplies 2 selector bits per pixel; each pixel copies the chosen palette float4 into the output array a1 (four consecutive floats per pixel).

local_names.a2: input block: two 16-bit endpoint colors followed by a 32-bit selector mask
local_names.pal: stack-resident 16-float palette built from the two decoded endpoints

operations.description: Decode the first 16-bit endpoint color at a2[0] into the four-float buffer v15..v18 via F_16BitColorToFloat4Decoder
Decode the second 16-bit endpoint color at a2[1] into the four-float buffer v19..v22 via F_16BitColorToFloat4Decoder
When endpoint word 0 > endpoint word 1, build the 4-color palette: per channel, the two midpoints are computed at 0.33333334 and 0.66666669 fractions between the two decoded endpoints
Otherwise (word 0 <= word 1) build the 2-color palette: per channel a single 0.5 midpoint, with the remaining palette slots zeroed (0.0)

Expand the 32-bit selector mask (read at a2+4): 16 iterations, each taking 2 selector bits, selecting the corresponding palette float4 and writing it to the output array at a1 (floats at a1[0..3], advancing 4 floats per pixel, which corresponds to this+0x0 / +0x4 / +0x8 / +0xC)
Return 0; DXT-style block decompression helper called by sub_51512C (0051512c) and sub_5151AF (005151af)

clean_pseudocode: a1[0] = pal[4*index+0]; a1[1] = pal[4*index+1]; a1[2] = pal[4*index+2]; a1[3] = pal[4*index+3];
